items.title: Base creator Jesse Pollak says equities and non-dollar stablecoins will lead upcoming ‘tokenization supercycle’
items.summary: Coinbase launched tokenized stocks on Base six weeks ago, with about $70 million to $100 million in daily volume, according to Pollak.

items.title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
items.summary: The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.

items.title: Former Acting Chair Caroline Pham says CFTC can regulate almost everything except ‘onions and box office receipts’
items.summary: Pham said the CFTC's recent proposals are 'absolutely the kind of protection' needed for crypto retail traders in the United States.

items.title: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits
items.summary: The technical trial showed how AI agents could discover services and make micropayments using HSBC’s tokenized deposits, with real-time settlement and risk checks.

items.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
items.summary: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

items.title: StoneX raises Securitize price target 50% as tokenized stock platform opens new revenue stream
items.summary: StoneX lifts SECZ price target to $18 from $12, citing new revenue from the Securitize Stocks tokenized trading platform on Solana.

items.title: Morgan Stanley expects to support tokenized equities in Q1 2027, digital asset strategy head says
items.summary: Morgan Stanley is actively building the necessary infrastructure for tokenized equities while monitoring industry developments.
